_comment: Pre-existing defects found during the code-organization pass. They are recorded, not fixed, because fixing them changes product behaviour and that is a separate decision. The verify gate fails on anything NOT listed here, so this file must shrink over time — never grow to silence a new break.

unresolvedInlineHandlers.name: triggerResumeUpload
unresolvedInlineHandlers.problem: The 'Upload Resume (PDF)' zone on the Jobs page calls a function that is defined nowhere, so clicking it throws a ReferenceError and nothing happens.
unresolvedInlineHandlers.why_not_fixed: There is no resume-upload endpoint and no file storage anywhere in the backend, and the job-application flow collects a resume URL instead (app.js:5205). Implementing upload would be a new feature; deleting the zone removes a user-visible affordance. Both are product decisions, not refactoring.
